page.layout: One column of indexed lines, with three marginal catchwords at the right beside items 4, 5 and 6. Running head at the top. No page number. Ornament at the foot.

main_text.l: Siclus templi qualis, & quale numisma censûs.
Tributorum remissionem Principi esse honorificam; exactionem non raro necessariam.
4. Subditorum in Principem amor esto sincerus & candidus: amore
Consulendo vitæ Principis cum salutis suæ jactura:
Hosti non dedendo arces aut urbes:
A Principe non deficiendo : idq; ob perfidia mala & pestem, gravissimumq; supplicium.
5. Principes, etiam σχολιοὶ ἢ[?] ἀσχολοι, patientiâ honorandi. patientiâ
6. Subditis nova Rerumpublicarum mutationes fugiendæ: ob plurima, eas quæ comitantur, incommoda. novarum fugâ
7. Subditi cum seditiosis ne commiscentor. Hic simul agitur,

page.notes: The marginal catchwords "amore", "patientiâ" and "novarum fugâ" are printed beside items 4, 5 and 6 and are placed inline at those lines. The Greek in item 5 is set in a small italic and the second word is read as ἢ; this is doubtful. The ornament ")(:(" at the foot is a printer's ornament and is not transcribed as text. The running head and the title are set in small capitals. No page number is printed.
